Database._comment: Provider: Sqlite | Postgresql | MySql | MsSql. If ConnectionString is empty, a default local SQLite database is created automatically.

AttachmentStorage._comment: Provider: FileSystem | Ftp. Files are stored once under their SHA-256 hash. A relative FileSystem.RootPath is resolved against the application directory. MaxFileSizeBytes is the largest attachment accepted (26214400 = 25 MB); the server's request size limit and the limit shown in the client follow it. Behind IIS, values above about 28 MB also need requestLimits maxAllowedContentLength in web.config. MaxTotalBytesPerUser is the total size of the attachments one user may keep (1073741824 = 1 GB, 0 = no limit); every file a user uploaded counts until it is deleted.

Security._comment: Defaults for locking an account after failed logins, self-registration and the password policy. An administrator can override them in the admin panel; saved values are kept in the database.

PasswordPolicy._comment: Rules for new passwords (MinLength 4-64). Like the values above, these are defaults an administrator can override in the admin panel. Existing passwords keep working until they are changed.

GoogleAuth._comment: OAuth 2.0 Web client ID from Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services > Credentials). Leave empty to turn Google sign-in off. The client's Authorized JavaScript origins must list the address the Angular app is served from.

RateLimiting._comment: Requests allowed per caller (signed-in user, or IP address when anonymous) in each window. AuthPermitLimit applies per IP address to login, registration and 2FA verification.

ReverseProxy._comment: Set Enabled to true when the API runs behind a reverse proxy (nginx, IIS ARR, a load balancer), so the client address is read from X-Forwarded-For. A proxy on the same machine is trusted automatically; list any other in KnownProxies (IP addresses) or KnownNetworks (CIDR, for example 10.0.0.0/8). Leave it off when the API is reached directly, otherwise callers on the local machine could forge their address.

Cors._comment: Default Angular port is 4200, but on machines where Hyper-V/WSL reserves that range use --port 4600 (see README) and keep this list in sync.
